name: High Roller / four-live-late-roll-distinct-targets-and-real-damage
notes: Repair-only. Declare two separate Intimidate targets before asset costs even before a roll; evaluate printed Red4+ condition only on resolution. Same Hero across separate instances is an inference from CR1.8.5b and Everfest two-instance note, informed by supplied rules-chat interpretation, not a published card ruling. Never select a new target at resolution. All four young20 heroes live/manual; all priority responses native. A real Bone Head Barrier Instant rolls after High Roller was declared; original hands must remain intact until High Roller itself resolves. Then exactly two distinct physical cards are banished facedown to their owners.  UPF TRP9.3: adjacent heroes only; separate one-target effects do not receive multi-target adjacency exception. Start with one resource to pay the printed one-resource Bone Head Barrier cost; no die/bonus outcomes preseeded.
